# QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem.fromEpsgId

## Syntax
static fromEpsgId(epsg: int) -> QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem

## Description
Creates a CRS from a given EPSG ID. This method uses an internal cache to speed up creation of multiple CRS with the same definition. Call invalidateCache() to clear the cache. QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem matching CRS, or an invalid CRS if string could not be matched

```python
from qgis.core import QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem
result = QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem.fromEpsgId(epsg)
```

# QgsCoordinateTransform.transform

## Syntax
transform(self, point: QgsPointXY, direction: Qgis.TransformDirection = Qgis.TransformDirection.Forward) -> QgsPointXY

## Description
Transform the point from the source CRS to the destination CRS. If the direction is ForwardTransform then coordinates are transformed from source to destination, otherwise points are transformed from destination to source CRS. point (QgsPointXY) – point to transform QgsCsException – if the transformation fails transform(self, x: float, y: float, direction: Qgis.TransformDirection = Qgis.TransformDirection.Forward) -> QgsPointXY Transform the point specified by x,y from the so

```python
from qgis.core import QgsCoordinateTransform
result = QgsCoordinateTransform.transform(point, direction)
```

# QgsProject.transformContext

## Syntax
transformContext(self) -> QgsCoordinateTransformContext

## Description
Returns a copy of the project’s coordinate transform context, which stores various information regarding which datum transforms should be used when transforming points from a source to destination coordinate reference system. QgsCoordinateTransformContext

```python
from qgis.core import QgsProject
result = QgsProject.transformContext()
```

# QgsDistanceArea.measureLength

## Syntax
measureLength(self, geometry: QgsGeometry) -> float

## Description
Measures the length of a geometry. geometry (QgsGeometry) – geometry to measure length of geometry. For geometry collections, non curve geometries will be ignored. The units for the returned distance can be retrieved by calling lengthUnits(). QgsCsException – if a transformation error occurs while calculating the length

```python
from qgis.core import QgsDistanceArea
result = QgsDistanceArea.measureLength(geometry)
```
